original.question: Indawo ye-Billie igumbi lokulala engunxande yi-360 izinyawo zesikwere. Ukuba ubude begumbi buyi-3 yadi, ngubani umjikelezo wegumbi ngezinyawo?
original.answer:
Ubude begumbi buyi-3 yadi * (3 izinyawo / 1 yadi) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 izinyawo.
Ububanzi begumbi buyi-360 izinyawo zesikwere / 9 izinyawo = <<360/9=40>>40 izinyawo.
Umjikelezo wegumbi ngu-2(40+9) = 98 izinyawo
